days.title: Renaissance Architecture and Cinema in Pienza
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pienza
stops.detail: Crossed by the Orcia river in the center, which gives it its name, it is characterized by pleasant landscapes and various centers of medieval origin, two of which are very well known, such as Pienza and Montalcino.

stops.name: Rovere delle Checche
stops.detail: Also worth mentioning is the famous monumental tree Rovere delle Checche, in the municipality of Pienza.

stops.name: Castiglione d'Orcia
stops.detail: The Val d'Orcia is an area of high tourist interest thanks to its historical-landscape peculiarities, such as the Velona Castle, as well as characteristic villages such as San Quirico d'Orcia and Castiglione d'Orcia.

stops.name: San Quirico d'Orcia
stops.detail: Inside the natural area, the famous cypresses of San Quirico d'Orcia are also worth noting.
